a: Java is a widely used OOP language that runs on the JVM.
The JVM executes Java bytecode and provides portability across OSes.
A class is a blueprint; an object is an instance of a class.
Inheritance lets a class extend another to reuse and specialize behavior.
Interfaces define method contracts that implementing classes must fulfill.
Checked exceptions must be declared or handled; unchecked are RuntimeExceptions.
List, Set, Map are core collection interfaces in java.util.
Streams support functional-style map/filter/reduce over collections.
Spring is a major framework for Java enterprise and web applications.
GC automatically reclaims memory for unreachable objects on the JVM.
